# JDKD Corporate Tower

> JDKD Corporate Tower is a LEED certified, Grade A commercial office building at A-11, Mohan Co-operative Industrial Estate, Mathura Road, New Delhi-110044, built by JDKD Developers LLP. It is available for leasing now.

Seven office floors over two basements on a 23,456.16 sq.ft (2,179.13 sq.m) plot, with 14 ft 9 in (4.5 m) floor heights. The building is earthquake-resistant and has solar panels, rainwater harvesting, a sewage treatment plant and a fresh air system. It is 350 m from Sarita Vihar Metro on the Violet Line, 500 m from Apollo Hospital and 5 km from the NOIDA business hub, with direct access off Main Mathura Road.
